name: Hakkar banished from Azeroth

date.label: WoW Classic Zul'Gurub campaign; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Blizzard's Burning Crusade Classic retrospective records that Hakkar was banished to the plane from which he came. This closes the immediate Zul'Gurub threat in that Classic-era account; the summary does not name individual victors or establish a causal link to Yeh'kinya's Ancient Egg.
